issue_context.title: goroutine leaks in several tests
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

Similar to #107191, goroutines associated with QueueBroadcaster and EventWatcher are leaked in the following tests: 

1. `TestAllocateOrOccupyCIDRSuccess()` at [line 321](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/nodeipam/ipam/range_allocator_test.go#L321) of pkg/controller/nodeipam/ipam/range_allocator_test.go

2. `TestDaemonSetUpdatesNoTemplateChanged()`  at [line 336](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/daemon/update_test.go#L336) of pkg/controller/daemon/update_test.go

3. ` TestRepair()` at [line 55](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/registry/core/service/ipallocator/controller/repair_test.go#L55) of pkg/registry/core/service/ipallocator/controller/repair_test.go

4. `TestDeploymentController_cleanupDeploymentOrder()` at [line 452](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/deployment/sync_test.go#L452) of pkg/controller/deployment/sync_test.go

5. `TestUpdatePods()` at [line 681](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/replicaset/replica_set_test.go#L681) of pkg/controller/replicaset/replica_set_test.go

6. `TestSyncDeploymentCreatesReplicaSet()` at [line 269](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/deployment/deployment_controller_test.go#L269) of pkg/controller/deployment/deployment_controller_test.go

7. `TestMultipleServiceChanges()` at [line 2209](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/endpoint/endpoints_controller_test.go#L2209) of pkg/controller/endpoint/endpoints_controller_test.go

Moreover, `TestMultipleServiceChanges()` can trigger a runtime panic by sending a message to a closed channel. The buggy channel is `blockNextAction`. The send operation is at [line 175](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/6845df17290505ad6d989463f5bca2fbbd619c03/pkg/controller/endpoint/endpoints_controller_test.go#L175)  in `func makeBlockingEndpointDeleteTestServer()`. The close operation is at [line 2265](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/6845df17290505ad6d989463f5bca2fbbd619c03/pkg/controller/endpoint/endpoints_controller_test.go#L2265)  in `TestMultipleServiceChanges()` 

### What did you expect to happen?

no goroutine leaks

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

run those unit tests

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_

### Kubernetes version

all versions after 97d40890d00acf721ecabb8c9a6fec3b3234b74b
